## Appearance

Stacy is noted for her lovely, fair, curly hair. She is also described as having fascinating eyes.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041)_

## Personality

Stacy is a bright and sympathetic young woman. She possesses a natural ability to easily win and maintain the affection of her pupils.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)_

## History

Miss Stacy became the new schoolteacher in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), quickly winning the devotion of her pupils, including [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), through engaging school activities, field afternoons, and organizing a Christmas concert to buy a school flag. Maintaining perfect order without ever whipping her students, she confirmed she would return for a second year of teaching. Throughout the following school year, Miss Stacy provided careful guidance to prepare [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her classmates for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination, even accompanying them to town to sit for the test.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXII. Anne Is Invited Out to Tea P0](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XXII. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--stacy.md)

Stacy serves as Anne's beloved schoolteacher and academic mentor, earning Anne's instant devotion upon her arrival in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). She fosters Anne's intellectual growth through engaging assignments, field afternoons, and special preparation for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations. Under Stacy's encouragement and guidance, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) successfully ties for first place on the entire island on the entrance exams.

- Friend of — teacher and student friend  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>
